Gemini 4 Argon SF Hackathon
San Francisco, CASun, Oct 25 at 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM (PDT)
Gemini 4 Argon is here. What will you build with it?

Push the boundaries of what's possible with Argon. Join Google DeepMind in San Francisco to explore the frontier, from advanced reasoning and visual coding to robotics and world models.

We're looking for ambitious projects that push Argon to its limits. We want to see something that wasn't possible last week.

Prizes

We've got $20K in cash prizes lined up for winning teams.

First place: $7,500

Second place: $5,000

Third place: $2,500

Best use of Managed Agents: $5,000

We'll have the Deepmind team in house for judging and speaking including Ivan Leo. More judges from the ecosystem announced soon, stay tuned!

Note: This event is fully in-person in San Francisco. Space is limited. Maximum team size is four. All attendees must apply and be approved. Submitting an application does not guarantee attendance.

About Event

Agenda
6:00 PM: Doors open

6:30 to 7:15 PM: Panel

After that: Free conversation and networking

"The way to get startup ideas is not to try to think of startup ideas. It's to look for problems, preferably problems you have yourself." Paul Graham

Most people who want to build something sit in a room and brainstorm ideas. That is the wrong starting point.

The right starting point is a real problem. That is the ITCH worth scratching.

If you do not have that problem yourself, come find it here. ITCH is a panel discussion with business owners or industry experts in the SF community. We dig into what is actually hard in their business right now. Together, we find the ITCH.

You leave with a list of real problems you can actually work on. And some of the panelists might let you pilot your solution with them directly.You can find ways to leverage AI for these problems.

Industry
We're inviting a San Francisco retail owner who runs a physical clothing store and also designs and manufactures their own clothing line.

ITCHATHON
Two days later we run the ITCHATHON, a hackathon where we solve the problems we found here. Sign up for that too →

This is for anyone who wants to build something. A startup, a side project, or just something for your CV. Up to you.

Come and leave with an ITCH.September 24th, 6 PM

Join the Omarchy meetup in San Francisco
• Food + Drinks
• Lightning demos

Bring your laptop and show us what you have built with Omarchy. Share themes, plugins, workflows, agents, hardware, hacks. Or just come hang and get inspired by how other people made Linux theirs.
Interested in speaking? @stevederico on X

We meet in San Francisco to talk Omarchy, Linux, open source, programming, customization, and the rest of adjacent builder culture. Bring a laptop if you want to install or customize. Or just come hang, see machines running, and meet other people who think Linux can be fun, beautiful, and actually good with agents.
Tech talks, install nights, workshops, and the occasional hack night. Community-run. Not an official Omarchy or Omacom Foundation event.
